tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Use this to find games for a group when you don't have a specific game in mind ("3 friends, one on PS5 and one on Xbox"). Searches CoopGames' catalog of co-op and multiplayer games (PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox, Switch, Switch 2). All filters are optional and combine with AND. With several platforms it return

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Use this when the user names a specific game and wants the full multiplayer picture: platforms, online and same-screen player counts, crossplay for every pair of its platforms, session length, whether one copy is enough for the group, and the link to its CoopGames page. Accepts the game name or slug

tools.name: crossplay_check
tools.description: Use this for a quick yes/no: can players on two different platforms play this game together online? Returns crossplay true or false plus the game page url. Returns false with a reason if the game is not on both platforms. PS4 with PS5, Xbox One with Series and Switch with Switch 2 count as the same
